items.source:
Helper that for streaming chat responses, aggregate the chat response messages into a
single AssistantMessage. Job is performed in parallel to the chat response processing.
items.translation: 用于流式传输聊天响应的辅助工具，将聊天响应消息聚合为单个 AssistantMessage。该任务与聊天响应处理并行执行。

items.source: Christian Tzolov, Alexandros Pappas, Thomas Vitale, Heonwoo Kim
